title: The Nihilist Reading Of Castorice #Shorts
description:
The feeling that Castorice means something is a chemical event with an evolutionary address. Castorice (, CAST-er-iss, Chinese: 遐蝶; pinyin: Xiádié; lit. 'distant butterfly') is a character in the video game Honkai: Star Rail, developed by miHoYo. In the game, she is the demigod of death and one of the key figures in the story arc that takes place on the fictional planet called Amphoreus.

The psychology underneath Castorice is simpler and older than the story on top. Yonezawa praised Pollux's design as one of the game's best so far for an NPC, and for bringing representation to the game because the character uses a wheelchair. Editor MrSun of Yahoo News Taiwan praised the animation quality of her trailer and stated that people were asking when miHoYo would release a feature-length animation based on it.

Source: Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0). Made with AI assistance.
